acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Chicagoans' dreams of the Bulls, including interviews with Chicagoans.
acts.title: Bulls in Our Hearts

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Documentary story about a South Side Chicago barbershop where men gather to watch basketball.
acts.title: Bulls in a Barber Shop

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc:
Chicago playwright David Isaacson, on hating the Bulls.
Then, Nancy Updike presents a sound portrait of a Philadelphia woman and her basketball trophies.
acts.credits: By Ira Glass, David Isaacson, Nancy Updike
acts.title: The Meaning of Basketball

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc:
Chicago playwright Beau O'Reilly goes with Ira to the Scottie Pippen Dodge Store.
Then, singer/songwriter/playwright Jeff Dorchen on Niketown.
acts.credits: By Jeff Dorchen, Ira Glass, Beau O'Reilly
acts.title: Basketball and Commerce

acts.label: Act Five
acts.desc: A Bulls dream from Chicagoan Brett Grossman, and an acoustic guitar cover of Bulls theme music from Chicago musician Rick Karr.
acts.title: One More Dream
